title: 2024 AMC 8 Problem 19
statement: Jordan owns \(15\) pairs of sneakers. Three fifths of the pairs are red and the rest are white. Two thirds of the pairs are high-top and the rest are low-top. The red high-top sneakers make up a fraction of the collection. What is the least possible value of this fraction?

solutions.text:
Jordan has \(\dfrac{3}{5} \times 15 = 9\) pairs of red sneakers and \(6\) pairs of white sneakers. Moreover, \(\dfrac{2}{3} \times 15 = 10\) are high-top and \(5\) are low-top. If we want to minimize the number of red high-top sneakers, then we can set all \(6\) white sneakers to be high-top, leaving \(10-6=4\) red sneakers as high-top. Hence, the fraction of red high-top sneakers would be \(\dfrac{4}{15}\).

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: There are \(9\) red pairs and \(10\) high-top pairs
To minimize red high-tops, make as many white pairs high-top as possible
